author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
We are taking another shot at the headliner Gold Smaug the Magnificent, as well as chasing those incredible Book Cover Treatment cards from Magic: the Gathering The Hobbit!  We will be LIVE from Hobbytown in Louisville, KY.  Join us again on Saturday, August 8 from 1-4pm for a Meet & Greet with me as we celebrate the release of the set!

#mtgxhobbit #mtgambassador #magicthegathering
title: Hunting the Gold Smaug! Opening packs of Magic The Hobbit LIVE from Hobbytown!

author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Mike Turian, Sr. Executive Producer at Wizards of the Coast, talks about returning to Middle-earth with Magic: the Gathering The Hobbit!  We also chat about Mike sharing his love for both Tolkien and Magic with his dad.  Plus, some of the challenges of adapting The Hobbit!

#mtgxhobbit #magicthegathering #thehobbit
title: Designing MTGxHobbit with Mike Turian
